landing.documentTitle: Registration System for Churches | Camps, Retreats and Conferences

hero.title: Create your church's registration system in minutes
hero.subtitle: Custom form, online payments and complete management of camps, retreats, conferences and events — all in one place.

form.title: A Form Your Way
form.text: Build fields, sections and packages without coding. Every event looks like your church.

payment.title: Online Payment
payment.text: PIX, card and bank slip. The money goes straight to the church's account, with automatic transfer.

management.title: Complete Management
management.text: Registrations, spots, rooms, buses and reports brought together in a single dashboard.

checkin.title: QR Check-in
checkin.text: Confirm attendance at the event entrance from your phone, no paper and no lines.

differentials.title: Built for the Reality of the Church
differentials.lede: Selling tickets and collecting form responses is already everywhere. What doesn't exist is a system that also organizes the church event's operation — rides, rooms, teams, wristbands and check-in — integrated with payment, in a single flow.

transport.title: Rides and Transport
transport.text: Ride offers and requests among registrants and control of the church bus.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.text: Assign registrants to rooms, with companions, right from the dashboard.

teams.title: Teams and Crews
teams.text: Organize registrants into teams and service crews for the event.

checkin.title: Check-in and Wristbands
checkin.text: Attendance by QR or ID number, individual or by family, and wristband control.

packages.title: Packages and Batches
packages.text: Lodging, meals and transport by category, with pricing by age and by batch.

multievent.title: Multi-event
multievent.text: Camp, conference and retreat in the same account, each with its own page and registrations.

differentials.vsGoogleText: Here you get payment, packages, user accounts and event management — not just collecting responses.
differentials.vsGenericText: The form is yours, editable field by field, with rides, rooms, teams, wristbands and check-in, designed 100% for your church and/or organization.

purpose.title: Technology at the Service of Your Church
purpose.lede: We were born serving a local church's camp and grew alongside it. Our mission is to take the weight of organizing off the leadership's shoulders, so the church can focus on what matters: people and the Kingdom.

smallChurch.title: Serving the Small Church
smallChurch.text: The same tool the large church has, within reach of the small congregation — with no monthly fee that strains the budget.

stewardship.title: Stewardship and Trust
stewardship.text: The money belongs to the church and goes straight to its account. We don't hold anything; you stay in control.

dataCare.title: Care with Data
dataCare.text: Registrants' data handled with security and responsibility, in compliance with the LGPD.

simplicity.title: Simplicity
simplicity.text: Ready in minutes, with no need for IT. You build, publish and receive — and get back to caring for people. Any data can be edited by you at any time.

plans.title: Two Plans, No Monthly Fee
plans.lede: Choose the size of your church. Free account; you only pay when you create an event — and on paid ones, only on what you sell. The money goes straight to the church's account.
plans.essencialTagline: Form + registrations + check-in. For those who just need to register, receive and control entry.
plans.completoTagline: Everything in Essential + event logistics. For those who organize it all.
plans.footnote: No monthly fee — you pay as you go. The 14-day free trial applies only to free events; paid events already charge the fee per registration from the first sale.

ctaBand.title: Ready to Get Started?
ctaBand.text: Create your church's system now — it takes less than a minute and the account is free.

terms.s3Body: Registration payments are processed by a third-party payment provider. A platform fee, disclosed at the time the event is created, may apply to each paid registration.
